up: Retrieve up to 200 metabolism records involving CYP3A enzymes. Return the substrate canonical SMILES (structure), substrate compound name, metabolic conversion, pathway key, and organism. Filter the metabolism table where enzyme_name LIKE '%CYP3A%'. Join metabolism with compound_records on substrate_record_id to obtain the compound name, and join compound_records with compound_structures on molregno to obtain the canonical SMILES. Limit the result to exactly 200 rows.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles AS structure, cr.compound_name AS compound_name, m.met_conversion AS metabolic_conversion, m.pathway_key AS pathway, m.organism AS organism FROM metabolism m JOIN compound_records cr ON m.substrate_record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE m.enzyme_name LIKE '%CYP3A%' LIMIT 200
